parsed.explanation: 1. Well-formedness fix (critical): In BIBL 6 the closing tag </PRICE> did not match opening <PRIZE> - changed to </PRIZE> to make XML well-formed. 2. Semantic/tagging fix: <FORMAT>9. 1.</FORMAT> in BIBL 6 does not describe a format but a biblical verse reference (Psalm 125:1). Changed to <VERSE>9. 1.</VERSE> (alternatively <BIBL_SCOPE> or <CITATION>) and wrapped the loose untagged subtitle text 'gründlich vorgestellt über die Worte des 125. Psalms' that was outside any tag into the title context. 3. Character normalization (optional, for readability): decoded mojibake sequences (\u221a\u00bc -> ü, \u221a\u00a7 -> ä, \u221a\u2020 -> †) to proper UTF-8 German characters and dagger.
